features.name: mahalanobis_approx_distance
features.description: Approximate Mahalanobis-style distance from the training set centroid using per-feature z-score normalization, summed in quadrature. Captures how far a point is from the center of the feature space.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a scale-normalized distance metric from the global centroid, helping KNN identify outlier points that may be far from all neighbors.

features.name: plas_zscore
features.description: Z-score normalized plasma glucose concentration. Glucose is a primary diabetes indicator and scale normalization ensures proper distance weighting in KNN.
features.expected_model_benefit: Ensures glucose contributes proportionally to distance calculations without dominating due to scale differences.

features.name: mass_zscore
features.description: Z-score normalized BMI. BMI is strongly associated with metabolic conditions and proper normalization improves neighborhood geometry.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes BMI to unit variance so it contributes appropriately to KNN distance calculations.

features.name: age_zscore
features.description: Z-score normalized age. Age is a key risk factor and normalization prevents it from being overshadowed by higher-variance features.
features.expected_model_benefit: Ensures age contributes proportionally to KNN distance metrics.

features.name: glucose_bmi_interaction_norm
features.description: Product of z-score normalized glucose and BMI, capturing the joint metabolic risk signal. High values indicate co-elevation of both risk factors.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures interaction between two key metabolic risk factors in a scale-normalized form, improving neighborhood separation.

features.name: insulin_log_norm
features.description: Log-transformed and z-score normalized insulin level. Insulin has high skewness and large range; log transformation reduces outlier influence on distance calculations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces the outsized influence of extreme insulin values on KNN distance, improving neighborhood quality for typical cases.

features.name: pedi_age_combined_risk
features.description: Combined z-score of diabetes pedigree function and age, representing hereditary and temporal risk factors jointly normalized.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines two independent risk dimensions into a single normalized score, helping KNN find neighbors with similar risk profiles.

features.name: metabolic_syndrome_score
features.description: Composite score of normalized glucose, BMI, and insulin as a proxy for metabolic syndrome severity. Aggregates three correlated metabolic features.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a single composite metabolic feature that captures the dominant axis of variation, improving KNN cluster separation.

features.name: zero_feature_count
features.description: Count of physiologically implausible zero values across plas, pres, skin, insu, and mass. Zeros in these fields likely indicate missing data and affect distance calculations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Identifies data quality issues that affect distance reliability; rows with many zeros may cluster together artificially.

features.name: age_pregnancy_ratio_norm
features.description: Ratio of pregnancies to age, normalized by expected ratio at mean values. Captures reproductive history relative to age as a lifestyle indicator.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes a meaningful ratio feature that captures reproductive history intensity, adding a dimension not captured by raw features.

features.name: overall_metabolic_risk_judgment
features.description: Holistic semantic assessment of overall metabolic risk based on the combination of glucose level, BMI, insulin, pedigree function, and age. Score from 0 (low risk profile) to 10 (high risk profile) based on how many risk factors are simultaneously elevated above typical thresholds.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a human-interpretable composite risk score that helps KNN identify neighbors with similar overall metabolic burden.

features.name: data_completeness_quality_score
features.description: Semantic quality score from 0 to 10 assessing how complete and physiologically plausible the row's measurements are, considering whether key clinical values like glucose, BMI, blood pressure, and insulin are non-zero and within realistic human ranges.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps KNN weight neighbors by data reliability; rows with implausible zeros or extreme outliers should be treated differently in distance calculations.
